# konnect_org_notification_subscription (Resource)

OrgNotificationSubscription Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_org_notification_subscription" "my_orgnotificationsubscription" {
  destination_ids = [
    "6b198822-8087-4b99-866e-f660a7d847e7"
  ]
  enabled = true
  entities = [
    "..."
  ]
  event_type = "invoice-ready"
  name       = "...my_name..."
  regions = [
    "EU"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_ids` (List of String) IDs of 1 to 50 destinations that receive this event. Each ID must be unique.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to false to create the subscription in a paused state.
- `entities` (List of String) Entity IDs for which notifications are sent. Use `*` for all entities.
- `event_type` (String) Formatted string ID of the notification event.
- `name` (String) Name that identifies the subscription.
- `regions` (List of String) Regions for which notifications are sent. Use `*` for all regions.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) UUID v7 identifier of the subscription.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_org_notification_subscription.my_konnect_org_notification_subscription
  id = jsonencode({
    event_type = "invoice-ready"
    id         = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_org_notification_subscription.my_konnect_org_notification_subscription '{"event_type": "invoice-ready", "id": "..."}'
```
